title: Perfect Cuboid
exact_target: Is there a rectangular box whose three edges, three face diagonals and space diagonal all have positive integer lengths?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1302 (ALG-006). CC BY 4.0.
Aubrey de Grey, Philip Gibbs and Louie Helm, \emph{Novel required properties of, and efficient algorithms to seek, perfect cuboids}, arXiv:2401.06784v1 (2024), Section 1.
